description: plain integers sort numerically, not lexically (10 after 2)
numeric prefix is primary, letter suffix is secondary (2 < 5/a < 5/b < 10)
slash and bare-letter suffix variants of the same number stay grouped by number
leading zeros do not change the numeric value; the shorter (plain) form sorts first on a tie
a numeric chunk sorts before a non-numeric chunk at the same position (3 < A3)
letter comparison is case-insensitive, with uppercase before lowercase on an exact tie
multi-segment numbers compare segment by segment (1.2 < 1.10 < 2.1)
empty / blank strings sort after every real value
a realistic mixed guidebook page (numbers, slash sub-lines, a lettered variant)
